title: Procurement of Glasspanes,Repair,Maintenance and Replacement of Glass panes at Point Calimere Lighthouse station under Chennai directorate
summary: Two-cover e-tender for supply of 10 curved toughened lantern glass panes and replacement of damaged panes, rusted gutter-ring bolts and ventilators at the lantern house of Point Calimere Lighthouse, Nagapattinam District, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Point Calimere Lighthouse, Kodiakkarai post, Nagapattinam District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Supply and replacement of lantern glass panes, replacement of rusted bolts at CI gutter ring and outer gallery base, repair of ventilators

scope.item: Supply of 1550 mm x 820 mm x 10 mm curved toughened glass panes as per sample, drawing and specifications to Point Calimere lighthouse inclusive of template making, loading, packing, forwarding, freight and unloading

Dismantling of damaged glass panes (2 Nos) from lantern house astragal frame and replacement with new glass panes including fabrication, winch/lifting machinery, sealant, scaffolding, labour and freight
Removal of damaged rusted bolts and nuts at outer portion of CI gutter ring and outer gallery base support and fixing new bolts and nuts at lantern house
Repair of damaged ventilators at Point Calimere Lighthouse including material supply, fabrication and labour

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value as FDR from nationalized bank, valid six months after completion
money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalized bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid 90 days from technical bid opening; EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. 100% payment after satisfactory completion. MII purchase preference margin 20%. Penalty 0.1% per day up to 10%.

eligibility: OEMs or authorised agents or appropriate-class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies; registered bonafide fabricators/suppliers
Similar works in last seven years ending 28 February 2026: one >= 80%, two >= 50% or three >= 40% of tender value

Similar work: fabrication and supply of lantern house / CI gutter ring, supply and erection of high-rise steel towers, supply/replacement of glass panes at lantern house, steel fabrication or mechanical maintenance at high-rise towers
Turnover, P&L and auditor's report for 2022-23 to 2024-25; ITRs for same years; PAN; GST; litigation/blacklisting affidavit; key personnel details

Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory documents (business registration in Tamil Nadu/Puducherry or MSME/NSIC with TN/Puducherry address, PAN, GST, non-blacklisting affidavit) 20; turnover 15; ITR 15; similar work experience 30; performance of works 20
specs: Glass panes 1550 x 820 x 10 mm, toughened, curved (arc 835 mm), scratch resistant, fine finish, machined surface, to match approved sample; for 2.5 m lantern house
Packed in wooden pallets; damage until handover at contractor's cost
New GI bolts and nuts at CI gutter ring and outer gallery base support; ventilators repaired with new stainless steel meshes
Contractor to guarantee spares availability for 2 years
notes: Pages 1-3 have a text layer; pages 4-38 are scanned and were read by vision. Directorate contact e-mail printed is a gmail address used as the office e-mail (dlhlschennai@gmail.com). General conditions state rate validity 180 days while NIT and clause 3.15.5 state 90 days. BOQ price schedule carries zero-value template figures.
